title: Independently compare every table in full-store round-trips
outcome: A read-only independent SQLite comparator verifies complete current-profile source and imported stores without using the exporter manifest as its oracle.
acceptance: Negative tests detect missing categories, typed-cell changes, rowid or sequence changes and nonempty operational/provenance loss without printing private row content.
Run on the coherent real-store backup and imported candidate, with separately recorded strict doctor and read-only resume/history evidence.
The comparator checks schema and all durable tables including empty categories, raw SQLite cell types and bytes, rowids and sequence high-water; declared FTS is compared logically.

completion.summary: Independent full-store comparator delivered and accepted on V4: 16 discriminators, complete durable-table/type/rowid/sequence/logical-FTS comparison, real current round-trip plus separate healthy doctor and read-only history/resume checks. No activation or universal transformed-profile proof.
